## 17:46Z - Fix visual-gate redacted-email false blocker and pack accent contrast

- Work OS `f07eaada-b44c-41af-88e3-4c285e4efe7f`; worktree `/home/maigreeks/projects/.worktrees/launchloom-e2e-creative-audit`, branch `codex/launchloom-email-gate-and-accent-contrast`, based on `origin/main` (`1ce9ce6b`).
- Following PR #369 (`b2115077`, form-focus border clearance fix), fresh creative run `45863526575` for **Crestline Electrical** (`#367`) revealed two additional pipeline bugs:
  1. `scripts/visual-quality-gate-lib.mjs` intentionally redacts `business.email` to `business.hasEmail: true`, but `scripts/visual-quality-gate.mjs` (`GATE_SYSTEM_PROMPT`) did not instruct the vision model that a visible contact email is expected when `hasEmail` is true. As a result, `visual-quality-gate` flagged `zahemen9900@gmail.com is not in manifest` as a major `content-integrity` blocker on `candidate-a`, causing `attemptNearMissPreview` to fail and repeat 6 identical vision-gate calls on unchanged screenshots.
  2. When creative fell back to the experience pack, `templates/client-site/src/lib/color-policy.mjs` failed contrast on copper accent `#b4652a`: `accentTextColor` (`#ab5d20`) was only proved against `surfaceColor` (`#f8f6f0`) rather than `darkestLightBand` (`#eef1ea`, measuring `4.262 < 4.5`), and `accentTextDark` (`#c4743b`) had only `0.00088` margin over `4.5` (`4.50088` on `#142428`), dropping to `4.486` under browser `color-mix()` rounding.
- Fixes applied:
  - `scripts/visual-quality-gate.mjs`: document `manifest.business.hasEmail` in `GATE_SYSTEM_PROMPT` so verified visible contact emails are never flagged as missing from the manifest.
  - `scripts/run-rendered-creative-repair.mjs`: filter false-positive `content-integrity` findings complaining that `gateConfig.business.email` is missing from the redacted manifest, and deduplicate repeated `earlyNearMiss` vision-gate calls for unmodified candidates.
  - `templates/client-site/src/lib/color-policy.mjs` + `tests/color-contrast.test.ts`: prove `accentTextColor` against `darkestLightBand` on light pages and add `4.65` headroom to `accentTextDark` against `lightestDarkBand`.
- Next: verify tests, open and merge PR, verify deploy, and rerun **Crestline Electrical** (`#367`) through preview, admin approval, and client delivery.
